game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel, a glowing lava tube: the volcanologist must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the volcanologist's power beats the shield shown by lava imps.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel: a glowing lava tube
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read a rectangle's width and height. Calculate its area and display the result. Test dataset 10: {'width': 11, 'height': 12}; {'width': 13, 'height': 2}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comparison Duel' (Week 2 slot 5), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Lava Tube Tunnel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Reach the summit beacon using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The summit beacon reached with actions_used <= 15.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the summit beacon is reached, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Comparison Duel – Lava Tube Tunnel Trial
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
